errors.text_span: Пяттият сектор е синьо-сив, с етикет „Под 1 година“ и приблизителен процент 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The description invents a fifth "blue-grey" sector. The pie chart only shows four sectors. The category "Под 1 година" (Under 1 year) exists in the legend but has a value of 0% and no corresponding slice in the chart. The description also incorrectly assigns it a value of 13.6%, which belongs to the red sector ("Над 1 до 5 години").

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени върху кръга в низходящ ред по размер
errors.evidence: The claim that the sectors are arranged on the circle in descending order of size is incorrect. Visually, the slices are not sorted by size. For example, the smallest visible slice (red, 13.6%) is located between the largest slice (orange, 36.4%) and the second-largest slice (purple, 31.8%).
The list of sectors, which is supposed to be in descending order of size, includes the non-existent "синьо-сивия" (blue-grey) sector.
